tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List Okaab services
tools.description: List the software services Okaab offers (web development, mobile apps, 24/7 support, server deployment, SEO, pricing philosophy), with a short description of each.

locale.description: Language of the returned copy. 'en' English, 'ar' Egyptian Arabic. Defaults to 'en'.

tools.name: get_pricing_catalog
tools.title: Get pricing catalog
tools.description: Get Okaab's service catalog: project type, typical tech stack and typical timeline. Final scope and timeline are confirmed after a short discovery call.

locale.description: Language of the returned copy. Defaults to 'en'.

query.description: Optional free-text filter matched against the project type and stack, e.g. 'mobile', 'store', 'server'.

tools.name: get_process
tools.title: Get how Okaab works
tools.description: Get Okaab's working process (discovery, design, build & test, launch & support) plus a short description of the team.

locale.description: Language of the returned copy. Defaults to 'en'.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.title: Get Okaab contact details
tools.description: Get Okaab's public contact channels: WhatsApp number and link, general/sales/support email addresses, and the website URL.

tools.name: draft_quote_request
tools.title: Draft a quote request
tools.description: Build a ready-to-send quote request for Okaab from the caller's project details. Returns a formatted message plus a prefilled WhatsApp link and mailto link — it does not send anything itself.

name.description: Name of the person or company requesting the quote.

phone.description: Contact mobile number, including country code.

service.description: Type of service needed, e.g. website, e-commerce store, dashboard, mobile app, servers, SEO.

details.description: Description of the project: goals, scope, budget and timeline if known.
